definition.description: Balance share of loans whose valuation is above `amount`.

provenance.sourceText: 1. The Current Balance of Eligible Mortgage Loans secured by Mortgaged Properties with an Original Valuation greater than £1,500,000 as a percentage of the Concentration Limit Denominator shall not exceed 10%.

definition.description: Balance share of loans whose valuation is below `amount`.

provenance.sourceText: 2. The Current Balance of Eligible Mortgage Loans secured by Mortgaged Properties with an Original Valuation less than £150,000 as a percentage of the Concentration Limit Denominator shall not exceed 10%.

definition.numerator: Sum of balance for every loan of each borrower whose aggregate balance is above (or below) `amount`.
definition.description: Balance share held by borrowers whose TOTAL lending across all their loans breaches `amount`. The aggregate is struck per borrower, so a borrower with several small loans can qualify while no single loan would — which is the point of the covenant.

provenance.sourceText: 1. The Current Balance of all Eligible Mortgage Loans made to any Borrower with an aggregate initial principal balance greater than £1,000,000 as a percentage of the Concentration Limit Denominator shall not exceed 10%.

definition.description: Simple average balance per loan (original or current basis).

provenance.sourceText: 2. The average initial principal balance of Eligible Mortgage Loans in the Financing Portfolio shall not be greater than £300,000.

definition.numerator: Sum of balance where the basis age satisfies the comparison.
definition.description: Balance share of loans where the borrower age (youngest or oldest basis) is below or above `age`.

provenance.sourceText: 1. The aggregate Current Balance of Eligible Mortgage Loans made to Borrowers where the sole Borrower or the youngest Borrower is below 55 years of age as a percentage of the Concentration Limit Denominator shall not exceed 0%.

definition.numerator: Sum of balance for joint-borrower loans.
definition.description: Balance share of loans with joint borrowers. The joint definition (structure flag vs borrower count) is a governed parameter, not a guess.

provenance.sourceText: 2. The Current Balance of all Eligible Mortgage Loans which have two Borrowers as a percentage of the Concentration Limit Denominator shall not exceed 90%.

measureDefinitions.definition: Current balance of every loan in the facility's Financing Portfolio, whatever its eligibility status.
Current balance of loans whose governed eligibility status is ELIGIBLE.
Current balance of loans whose governed eligibility status is INELIGIBLE.
Current balance of loans whose eligibility cannot yet be determined — never counted as eligible.
Number of loans whose governed eligibility status is ELIGIBLE.
The facility's contractual advance rate, as a percentage.
Eligible current balance x advance rate, before the facility cap.
MIN(gross borrowing base, facility commitment) — the available borrowing base.
Current drawings under the facility, as supplied by the operator.
Available borrowing base minus current drawings. Retained negative when the facility is over-drawn.
ABS(MIN(headroom, 0)) — the amount by which drawings exceed the available borrowing base.
Current drawings as a percentage of the available borrowing base.
Current drawings as a percentage of the facility commitment.
The binding Schedule 8 concentration limit, chosen deterministically: any breach outranks any non-breach; among breaches the largest utilisation binds; otherwise the smallest headroom binds.
Percentage-point headroom on the binding concentration limit.
Headroom on the binding concentration limit converted to currency at that test's own denominator.
How many Schedule 8 concentration limits are currently breached.
